'''Coccia''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]], located in the [[Felucia system/Legends|Felucia system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Coccia occupied the first [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Felix/Legends|Felix]] and had one [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The planet featured a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] environment and had a surface of scorched [[Stone/Legends|rock]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coccia was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-6.<ref name="TEA" />
